title: AgentTypeParams
description: Params for agent.type. THE AGENT IS NOT HERE, and its absence is the design: a caller that could name the agent could name one whose rule verifies while the pane runs something else, and the frame would then be read by a rule that was never about it. The agent comes from the enrolment act, which is also what opened the grid the frame is read from.

sessionId.description: The pane to type into, by the session that is its pipe. The connection must hold it, exactly as the data plane requires before it will carry a byte the person typed.

text.description: What to type. It is framed as a bracketed paste on the way in, so a line break inside it is content rather than a submission. Text carrying a control character is refused whole rather than repaired: inside a paste an escape ends the paste early and everything after it stops being text and starts being keys.

submit.description: Whether the key that submits is pressed after the text, as a SEPARATE write gated on its own frame. Absent means false, and the default is the safe direction on purpose: a caller that forgot the field leaves its text in the input region for a person to look at, rather than starting a turn nobody asked for.
